I get really anxious about final exams, and then the night before I just can’t sleep properly, and my stomach gets all upset. It sounds dramatic, I know, but these exams are killing me… I mean that figuratively, not like, you know.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly just to get through finals without totally falling apart, and to be able to sleep the night before exams.
